workload_work_year_days_001.answer: 192 days (10-month ET-15); 210 days (11-month ET-15/11); 228 days (12-month ET-15/12)
workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: The work year for 10-month ET-15 Teachers shall be one hundred ninety-two (192) days... The work year for eleven-month Teachers shall be two hundred ten (210) days... The work year for twelve-month Teachers shall be 228 days.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: 7.5 consecutive hours (7:30 AM–4:30 PM) for ET-15/ET-15/12 Teachers; 40 hours/week for EG-09 Teachers
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: The work day for ET-15 and ET-15/12 Teachers shall be seven-and-one-half (7.5) consecutive hours beginning no earlier than 7:30 AM and ending no later than 4:30 PM... The workweek for EG-09 Teachers shall be forty (40) hours.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: All Teachers serving in elementary schools shall receive two hundred twenty-five (225) minutes per week for planning periods. All secondary school teachers shall be given at least five (5) daily planning periods per week...

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: 225 minutes per week for elementary teachers; at least 5 daily periods (equal in length to a class period) for secondary teachers
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: All Teachers serving in elementary schools shall receive two hundred twenty-five (225) minutes per week for planning periods. All secondary school teachers shall be given at least five (5) daily planning periods per week that are equal in length to a class period

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: The Parties agree that planning periods shall be used for instructional purposes: planning lessons, reviewing student work, maintaining student records, holding conferences, and other similar activities. ... In instances where a special subject Teacher is not available to provide coverage for a Teacher’s scheduled planning period, the building Supervisor shall seek a substitute or utilize an alternative planning schedule.

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: In secondary schools, each Teacher shall have a duty-free lunch period equal in length to a full teaching period... A duty-free lunch period shall not include the supervision of students. In the elementary schools... each Teacher shall have a minimum forty-five (45) minute, duty-free, uninterrupted lunch period each day.
